title: Acknowledger
tagline: Peer-to-peer recognition tied to your community values, culture, and performance.
description:
Acknowledger is a platform that empowers communities with a mechanism that encourages to "watch" and "recognize" bar-raising behaviors - daily - without pain-staking process-reviews-approvals while creating a  culture of continuous improvement, increasing engagement and commitment.

It leverages non-fungible, soulbound tokens that represent recognition or feedback deployed in Optimism, Zora or Base testnets.

Through blockchain, feedback is captured in a timeless manner and users can showcase their own feedback wall via public URL on their own, personal wall.

The modern way to create "thank you" notes that are immortal.
how_its_made:
Acknowledger is a NextJS project with data fully stored on-chain. When people create an acknowledgement or feedback, this the SBT is minted into the recipient's wallet based on the network selected (currently supported Optimism, Zora and Base testnets).

This soulbound NFT carries information about the text containing the feedback, the author and the relation with the recipient and a list of attributes of values the person showcase as part of the feedback.

The acknowledgements wall loads all NFTs from all the 3 testnets above (using Covalent NFT API) and filters by the smart contracts from the project. It then lists all NFT content feedback, values, author and relation with the recipient. The avatars and the ENS resolutions are retrieved using ENS subgraph from TheGraph.

The main description and traits (displayed in the top center of the screen next to the avatar, are GPT generated content based on all the testimonial the address has.

The project is hosted in vercel and landing page styles was built using webstudio.so
